description_en: Retrieves the details of a machine group
description_zh: 您可以通过GetResourceGroupMachineGroup获取机器组的详情
kebab_example: aliyun paistudio get-resource-group-machine-group --machine-group-id mgmioirqjgw6c5lg --resource-group-id rgf0zhfqn1d4ity2 --api-version 2022-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResourceGroupMachineGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the machine group
parameters.name: machine_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. Each resource group has a globally unique ID. You can use the resource group ID to retrieve the information about the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组 ID，每一个资源组都有全局唯一的资源组ID。可以通过资源组ID来获取资源组的信息
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 实例的标签键。N 的取值范围为 1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 实例的标签值。N 的取值范围为 1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags to add. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 对应新增标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

AllocatableCpu.description_en: The number of allocatable CPU cores on each machine in the machine group
AllocatableCpu.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器用户可分配的CPU核数

AllocatableMemory.description_en: The allocatable memory size on each machine in the machine group
AllocatableMemory.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器用户可分配的内存大小

Cpu.description_en: The total number of CPU cores on each machine in the machine group
Cpu.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器的CPU总核数

DefaultDriver.description_en: The default GPU driver version of each machine in the machine group
DefaultDriver.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器的默认的显卡驱动的版本

GmtCreatedTime.description_en: The time when the machine group was created

GmtExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the machine group

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the machine group was updated

GmtStartedTime.description_en: The time when the machine group was started

Gpu.description_en: The number of GPU cores on each machine in the machine group
Gpu.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器的GPU核数

GpuType.description_en: The GPU type of each machine in the machine group
GpuType.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器的GPU卡型

MachineGroupID.description_en: The ID of the machine group

Memory.description_en: The memory size of each machine in the machine group
Memory.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器的内存数

Name.description_en: The name of the machine group

PaymentDuration.description_en: The billing duration. If PaymentDurationUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60

PaymentDurationUnit.description_en: The billing duration unit of the machine group

ResourceGroupID.description_en: The ID of the resource group. Each resource group has a globally unique ID. You can use the resource group ID to retrieve the information about the resource group
ResourceGroupID.description_zh: 资源组 ID，每一个资源组都有全局唯一的资源组ID。可以通过资源组ID来获取资源组的信息

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Creating: The instance is being created.
Ready: The instance is running.
Expiring: The instance is about to expire.
Expired: The instance has expired.
Stopping: The instance is being stopped.
Stopped: The instance is stopped
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。
Creating：创建中
Ready：运行中
Expiring: 即将过期
Expired: 已过期
Stopping：停止中
Stopped：已停止

SupportedDrivers.description_en: The GPU driver versions supported by nodes in the machine group
SupportedDrivers.description_zh: 机器组中节点支持的GPU显卡驱动版本

SystemReservedCpu.description_en: The number of system-reserved CPU cores on each machine in the machine group
SystemReservedCpu.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器系统预留的CPU核数

SystemReservedMemory.description_en: The size of system-reserved memory on each machine in the machine group
SystemReservedMemory.description_zh: 机器组中每一台机器系统预留的内存大小

Tags.description_en: The list of tags to query. The value is a JSON string that contains up to 20 tags
Tags.description_zh: 要查询的Tags列表，采用JSON字符串的形式，最多包含20个子项

items.description_en: The label array. The number of array element N ranges from 1 to 20
items.description_zh: 标签数组。数组元素个数N取值范围：1~20

TagKey.description_en: The key of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
TagKey.description_zh: 实例的标签键。N 的取值范围为 1~20

TagValue.description_en: The value of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
TagValue.description_zh: 实例的标签值。N 的取值范围为 1~20
